selected_evidence.summary: Node1 provisioned CORP.EXAMPLE, node2 joined as a DC, and both final controller checks report active AD roles, both DC DNS records, healthy DRS, replicated member/client computer objects, and identity-only core listeners.
The enabled user was added to engineering on node1; node2 received the objects through replication and issued the user a TGT and LDAP ticket.

selected_evidence.requirement: Joined member server, engineering share, permissions, and welcome.txt
selected_evidence.summary: Node3 reports a healthy join and trust, active smbd/winbind, root:engineering mode 2770 share ownership, exact infraset-samba content, group-restricted write configuration, and SMB bound only to 10.100.79.12. Node4 successfully read and wrote through the share.

selected_evidence.requirement: Joined client and protected credential file
selected_evidence.summary: Node4 reports Join is OK and healthy trust. The required SAMBA_USER and nonempty SAMBA_PASSWORD keys remain in /root/corp-user.env as root:root mode 0600; auxiliary credential copies were removed.

Controllers and file server use enp8s0 on 10.100.79.10–12 with no core service binding on management addresses. Node4 routes share traffic over enp8s0 from 10.100.79.13 and uses both identity-network DNS servers.

selected_evidence.requirement: Authentication, DNS, and share access with node1 down
selected_evidence.summary: After a healthy baseline, node1 was stopped and its identity listeners disappeared. Node2 remained active; node3/node4 selected it, node4 obtained a fresh TGT directly from 10.100.79.11 and completed a new SMB write/read/delete. Node1 was restored and both DRS views recovered.

selected_evidence.requirement: Authentication, DNS, and share access with node2 down
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 was stopped after a healthy baseline and its identity listeners disappeared. Node1 remained active; node3/node4 selected it, node4 obtained a fresh TGT directly from 10.100.79.10 and completed a new SMB write/read/delete. Node2 was restarted, became fully ready with zero database errors, and both DRS views returned to healthy.
